text: あきちで　あそぼうと　おもったのに　へんな　たてものが　できて　あそべなく　なっちゃった

structure.jp: あきちで　あそぼうと　おもったのに
structure.en: I was going to play in the empty lot, but

structure.jp: へんな　たてものが　できて
structure.en: a weird building got put up, and

structure.jp: あそべなく　なっちゃった
structure.en: now I can't play there anymore

patterns.name: 〜ようとおもう
patterns.span: あそぼうと　おもった
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus とおもう means 'I think I'll do it', a plan. あそぼうと　おもった = 'I was going to play'.

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.span: あそべなく　なっちゃった
patterns.explanation: なくなる after a verb means 'come to not do it anymore'. あそべ is the 'can play' form of あそぶ. あそべなく　なっちゃった = 'I've ended up unable to play'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the casual short form of てしまった, which says something happened completely and you're not happy about it. なっちゃった = 'it went and became that way'.
